messages.termLoad.TERM_CAPACITY_AVAILABLE: This term has {courseCount} courses. The normal limit is {normalCourseUnits}.
messages.termLoad.ECONOMICS_LOAD_ABOVE_PREFERENCE: This plan has {economicsCount} Economics courses in {term}. The department prefers no more than 2 per term, but the term is still within the normal course load.
messages.termLoad.TERM_OVERLOAD_APPROVED: In {term}, this plan has {courseCount} courses. The normal limit is {normalCourseUnits}. You recorded advisor approval and no academic probation.
messages.termLoad.TERM_OVERLOAD_APPROVED_WITH_RES: In {term}, this plan has {plannedCourseCount} courses plus room for {reservedCourseUnits} more. The normal limit is {normalCourseUnits}. You recorded advisor approval and no academic probation.
messages.termLoad.TERM_OVERLOAD_EVIDENCE_REQUIRED: This term would have {courseCount} courses. The normal limit is {normalCourseUnits}. You need advisor approval and must not be on academic probation.
messages.termLoad.TERM_OVERLOAD_APPROVAL_DENIED: This term would have {courseCount} courses, above the normal limit of {normalCourseUnits}. Advisor approval was not granted.
messages.termLoad.pending: A plan may need more than the normal course limit in {terms}. You need advisor approval and must not be on academic probation.
messages.termLoad.TERM_OVERLOAD_NOT_ALLOWED_ON_AC: This term would have {courseCount} courses, above the normal limit of {normalCourseUnits}. Overloads are not allowed during academic probation.
messages.termLoad.TERM_CAPACITY_EXCEEDED: This move would exceed the approved course limit for the term. Extra tuition does not raise that limit.
messages.tuition.threshold.exceeded: This plan totals {modeledUnits} courses in {period}. More than {threshold} may add tuition. Ask the Business Office.
messages.tuition.threshold.possible: This plan could total {modeledUnits} courses in {period}. More than {threshold} may add tuition. Ask the Business Office.
messages.tuition.threshold.withReserved: Your planned courses and saved room total {modeledUnits} courses in {period}. More than {threshold} may add tuition. Ask the Business Office.
messages.infeasibility.electives.spring: You still need {remainingElectives} Economics electives. No other eligible elective is offered in {winterTerm}. You can take only one of {springOptions} in {springTerm}.
messages.infeasibility.electives.conflict: {leftCourse} and {rightCourse} also meet at the same time.
messages.infeasibility.finance.forced: {financeCourse} counts for Finance here, so it cannot also count as an elective.
messages.infeasibility.capstone.seniorStanding: ECO 461 requires senior standing and is offered only in Winter. Your graduation year alone does not establish senior standing. Ask your advisor and the Registrar to confirm it, or choose a later graduation year.
messages.electivePlanning.limit: At most one Economics elective may be planned in an unpublished Fall, Winter or May term. Extra electives require matching verified sections and all academic checks.
messages.electivePlanning.named: This named future course needs a matching verified offering. Use an eligible elective slot or confirm the finance requirement with your advisor.
messages.allocation.financePetition: You may petition to count BUSN 323 as an Economics elective. This plan does not count it yet. Talk with your advisor about the petition.
